name: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades 2
summary: Shoot, loot, and scoot as a sentient hot dog in the sequel to Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades (H3VR), the award-winning, best-selling Immersive FPS. Master an arsenal of the best guns in VR. Fight your way through an endless proc-gen megastructure. Chill out and plink on the range. Wonderful!
